title: THE LAST SIGNAL
synopsis: A radio astronomer receives a signal from deep space that appears to contain a warning about Earth's future. As she races to decode it, she discovers the signal is coming from humanity itself — transmitted backward through time.

key_props.name: Camera P-14
key_props.description: Sarah's personal camera. Gets damaged in Scene 31 when she drops it during the first signal event. Damage is visible — cracked lens, dented body.

key_props.name: Signal Notebook
key_props.description: Sarah's hand-written analysis notebook. Entries accumulate across scenes.

key_props.name: Observatory Headphones
key_props.description: Vintage monitoring headphones Sarah uses at the dish array.

key_props.name: Security Badge
key_props.description: Sarah's facility access badge. Revoked in Scene 38.

demo_scenario.description: The script change demo: Scene 42 changes 'damaged camera' to 'undamaged camera', triggering a cascade of dependency conflicts.
